cases.native_requirement: five-slot caller/slot order and representative strict/equal retention

recovered_projection.slot_scan: The managed five-entry list is scanned by ascending list index.
recovered_projection.clear_point: Each in-use entry has isUsing cleared before Combo, score, Life, counters, callbacks, and total aggregation mutate.
recovered_projection.representative: A strictly greater raw result replaces the representative; equal raw result retains the first entry.

cases.native_requirement: sixth-slot failure and whole-domain mutation boundary
result, Combo, Fast/Slow, maxCombo, and all-perfect counters

counter_rules.combo: Positive addCombo updates current/max and live current/max using strict greater for maxima; negative addCombo resets current and live current to zero; zero is a no-op.
counter_rules.results: Miss/Bad/Good/Great each reset perfectCombo and increment their counter; Perfect increments both perfectCombo and perfectCount.
counter_rules.timing: JudgeTiming 1 increments Fast and JudgeTiming 2 increments Slow; all other values are no-op.

damage_mapping.skill_order: NoteFrontBase applies ordered active damage effects after selecting base damage and before OneFrameData Setup.

cases.native_requirement: same-frame multi-damage Life order and zero/Game Over boundary

life_rule.positive_delta: Rejected with return 0 once either single- or multi-game-over flag is set.
life_rule.negative_delta: Replaced with zero while immortalityTimer at +0x60 is greater than Float32 zero.
life_rule.clamp: The int32 sum is clamped to [0, value at +0x28].
life_rule.game_over: A resulting value <= 0 is stored as zero and updateGameOverState is called immediately.
life_rule.historical_1500_over_1000: The historical display is structurally possible without violating the business bound: current Life +0x20 may be 1500 while +0x24 remains 1000 and +0x28 is 2000. Runtime capture must still prove which UI field rendered the denominator.

cases.native_requirement: fixed/rate Damage Guard and guard type
Never Die nonlethal/lethal/equal boundary and resulting Life 5

never_die.replacement_delta: For lethal damage, return 5 - currentLife; otherwise preserve signedDamage.
never_die.guard_type: The Never Die path selects DamageGuardType 2.
